tools.name: search_laws
tools.description:
Find the AI-law rules that apply to an AI feature in a market.

When to use: someone asks which laws, regulations or standards apply to what they are building, or where a kind of
AI feature is regulated. jurisdictions: market codes (EU, US-CA, US-CO; US matches every state). features: AI
integration

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description:
One rule in plain terms: what it requires (TwinEthos's summary), who it applies to and the uses it excludes, its
dates, the exact citations with their official links, and the guard to add in one sentence.

When to use: after search_laws, or when someone names a rule id. It never returns the official

tools.name: plan_guards
tools.description:
The few guards that address the most rules for these AI features and markets, ranked: each guard in one sentence,
how many rules it addresses by lane, and where binding law on it applies.

When to use: someone asks what to build first, or how to cover several markets at once. Returns at most 5 guard

tools.name: coming_into_force
tools.description:
Binding AI-law obligations that start applying soon, by date, with citation, official link and the guard in one
sentence.

When to use: someone asks what is coming, or what to prepare for. Dates can change; returns at most 10.
